content:
**Retired the feature-PR memory transport surfaces; the lane is where a record travels (#890)**

**What**: memory.lane.enabled is true in brain.config.json; pre-push is checkpoint-only (canonical root, feature checkpoint, repository checks, size warning) and no longer transports durable records or blocks on a dirty .memory/; brain:save is deleted with no shim, alias or package script; brain:next derives its recommendation from branch issue provenance, the record reader, VCS PR state and lane configuration and recommends brain:memory:save --issue N or brain:ship; operator wording in i18n, bootstrap, commit-msg, memory-presence (semantics unchanged), plain backend and docs points at issue-scoped capture and the lane.
**Why**: memory 2.0 task 3.1d (#864). ADR-0034 ruled that records reach main on their own pull request, never the feature's; these were the surfaces that still made a record ride the branch.
**Where**: brain.config.json, brain/scripts/hooks/pre-push (+test), brain/scripts/brain-next.mjs (+test), brain/scripts/brain-save.mjs and test (deleted), package.json, brain/scripts/i18n/{en,es}.mjs, bootstrap.sh, hooks/commit-msg, governance/checks/memory-presence.mjs, harness/backends/plain.mjs, day-start.mjs, memory/staged-records-check.mjs, docs/**, README.md, openspec/changes/issue-890-retire-feature-pr-memory-surfaces/** (verify-report PASS WITH WARNINGS, three maintainer drafts).
**Learned**: Enabling the lane flag in tracked config turned an unmocked test into a live ship (PR #1007, #1012); fixed first in PR #1013. brain/core/managed-paths.mjs MANAGED_SCRIPT_KEYS still lists brain:save and brain/core/methodology/consolidation-protocol.md still describes the old pre-push; both wait for maintainer promotion of the drafts in brain-drafts/.
